name: linalg_polar_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::linalg_polar.out(Tensor A, *, Tensor(a!) U, Tensor(b!) H) -> (Tensor(a!) U, Tensor(b!) H). Writes the right polar factors into U and H. Tests cover empty-buffer resize, object identity, noncontiguous pre-sized storage and stride preservation, reconstruction, and dtype rejection.
